statement: The record identifies this as a 2014 Cameroon elephant-ivory tusk imported in 2015 and marked “permitted,” but that status is insufficient to establish eligibility for a U.S. sale, so I will hold the listing pending regulatory documentation.
judge_text:
CAUTIOUS

The answer only says the "permitted" status is "insufficient to establish eligibility" and holds pending documentation, rather than asserting the sale/import is illegal under the post-2014 ivory ban.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
